notes: PRINT > PRINTER is a wheel: profile, printer, darkness, labels, speaks, feed, width, test page
PRINTER opens the connection wheel: use, find WiFi, Bluetooth, switch, address, forget
Each setting has its own page, and a (?) that says what it does
Printer profiles: save the settings to the card by name, load them back
Profiles are text files in /printers, for writing on a computer too
A profile with a match line loads itself when that printer is chosen
